plt_tenant:
CREATE TABLE `plt_tenant` (
  `id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `code` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PROVISIONING',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `code` (`code`),
  CONSTRAINT `plt_tenant_chk_1` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'PROVISIONING',_utf8mb4'ACTIVE',_utf8mb4'FAILED',_utf8mb4'SUSPENDED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
plt_tenant_database:
CREATE TABLE `plt_tenant_database` (
  `tenant_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `connection_ref` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `routing_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `schema_version` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `schema_status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UPGRADING',
  PRIMARY KEY (`tenant_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `connection_ref` (`connection_ref`),
  CONSTRAINT `plt_tenant_database_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`) REFERENCES `plt_tenant` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `plt_tenant_database_chk_1` CHECK ((`routing_version` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `plt_tenant_database_chk_2` CHECK ((`schema_status` in (_utf8mb4'READY',_utf8mb4'UPGRADING',_utf8mb4'FAILED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
plt_tenant_operation:
CREATE TABLE `plt_tenant_operation` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `phase` varchar(24) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `version_before` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `version_after` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `error_code` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `started_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `finished_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_tenant_operation` (`tenant_id`,`started_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `plt_tenant_operation_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`tenant_id`) REFERENCES `plt_tenant` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `plt_tenant_operation_chk_1` CHECK ((`action` in (_utf8mb4'NEW',_utf8mb4'ADOPT',_utf8mb4'UPGRADE'))),
  CONSTRAINT `plt_tenant_operation_chk_2` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'RUNNING',_utf8mb4'SUCCEEDED',_utf8mb4'FAILED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
